$comment: Frozen starter predicate vocabulary — mirrors docs/CONTRACT.md section 9. Domain/range describe the intended subject/object entity types; 'string' in range marks free-text objects allowed for phase-1 wire claims.

predicates.name: announced
predicates.temporal_meaning: The date a public statement was made. Not the availability date; announcement and launch are different predicates.
predicates.description: Subject publicly announced the object (product, event, or free-text program) on/around the claim's valid time.

predicates.name: launched
predicates.temporal_meaning: The date the object became available. Distinct from announced; a near-conflict between announced and launched dates is benign.
predicates.description: Subject launched/made available the object on/around the claim's valid time.

predicates.name: has_ceo
predicates.temporal_meaning: The person held the CEO office during the claim's valid_time interval. Different CEOs at disjoint times are NOT contradictory.
predicates.description: Subject's chief executive officer is the object person, valid during the claim's validity interval.

predicates.name: located_at
predicates.temporal_meaning: The subject was located at the place during the claim's valid_time interval. Conflict findings require a justified temporal overlap.
predicates.description: Subject's location is the object place, valid during the claim's validity interval.

predicates.name: present_at
predicates.temporal_meaning: The person was present at the place/event during the claim's interval. Incompatible simultaneous presence findings require a defined incompatibility policy.
predicates.description: Person attended / was present at the object place or event.

predicates.name: happened_before
predicates.temporal_meaning: Strict partial order over events. Valid only when acyclic; a cycle is reported as a 'Potential temporal contradiction' with a witness path.
predicates.description: Event A happened strictly before event B.

predicates.name: cites
predicates.temporal_meaning: Static citation edge; no time semantics.
predicates.description: Document A cites document B as a source. Cycles enable circular-sourcing findings.
